articles.title: Google's Gemini AI can now call businesses for ...
articles.description: Google has introduced a new feature called "Call for Me" for its Gemini AI, allowing it to make calls to businesses on behalf of users. Initially available to Pixel 11 owners in the U.S. with a Gemini subscription and the beta Google Phone app, the AI can handle complex tasks like checking product availability, making reservations, or rescheduling appointments. Users can follow the call live via transcript and take over anytime. This builds on Google's previous AI calling experiments and aims to improve convenience in managing phone interactions with businesses.
